proposed_capability: P95/P124 and Trifecta P82/P07/P08. Add a bounded, opt-in supervised online valence classifier for per-Sim queued actions and whims with positive/negative/unknown separation, contextual reviewed evidence, patch-qualified incremental model snapshots and provenance protection. Extend the existing host listener read-only for positive/negative queue/whim review plus the three top-left Discovery Quests. Add whim-pin semantic action and a native click enqueue port that reuses screen_atlas cooperative player-idle admission, exact build, attested unique whim hitbox, current Sim selection, and no blind retry.
player_save_control_impact: No game setting or save mutation, no global input hooks, no personal names/raw screenshots, no daemon. Training requires operator review and consent; actor, source, exact installed patch, target, and UI capture proof. Learned predictions never cancel or pin actions on their own; click port needs existing user-idle lease, native game focus and exact center of selected pin affordance, no blind replay.
expected_outcome: Every bounded current queued action and whim has a transparent positive/negative/neutral/unknown bucket and distinct learned advisory score. Reviewed helpful/harmful examples update a bounded aggregate model across explicitly supplied prior snapshots; unknown model scores cannot assert harm. Opt-in host listener emits classification and a model advisory even for empty/busy queue. Three top-left modules are represented by canonical HUD result/registry; model outcome cannot override needs. Safe one-action whim-pin is supported by existing screen_atlas native click port when the exact selected Sim, visible whim and attested per-whim hitbox are supplied.
negative_tests: Never treat negative wish itself as a harmful queued action
Model-only harmful prediction cannot grant cancellation
Player-owned interactions and pinned whims always protected
Unknown actor, stale capture, unreviewed samples, bad patch, duplicate review ids, oversized batches fail closed
Whim pin without exact unique target, matching selected actor, current visible unpinned whim and cursor lease cannot click
No blind repeat after ambiguous input effect
All three top-left quest names are canonical but only independently active evidence may drive a goal; no generic multiple-quest guess
New fields optional and original host listener continues to work
No learning from passive mouse or click telemetry and no new daemons
rollback_path: Revert this isolated PR; code only, no native clicks executed or game state touched.
unresolved_unknowns: Local Sims 4 exact patch, valid whim pin hitboxes and single-click pin success remain P08 live certification
Self-learning from unreviewed behavior is deliberately disallowed; reviewed semantic outcome evidence is required for supervised training
